# Fine Art Tutorials

> A comprehensive online platform for learning drawing fundamentals, portraiture, and fine art techniques through self-paced courses and educational resources.

Fine Art Tutorials, founded by Emily Clare, offers structured drawing education ranging from beginner guides to advanced techniques like the Loomis Method and sight-size method. The platform combines video courses, eBooks, and tutorials to help artists develop core drawing skills.

## Key Topics

- Drawing Fundamentals
- Portrait Drawing
- Figure Drawing
- Loomis Method
- Sight-size Method
- Drawing Mastery eBook
- Beginner Drawing Guide
- Art Education
- Perspective and Shading
- Online Learning
- Drawing Techniques
- Emily Clare
- Artistic Fundamentals
- Drawing Skills
- Fine Art Education

## Core Courses

- [Drawing Fundamentals](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/drawing-fundamentals): Self-paced drawing course covering fundamentals, portraiture, and shading techniques
- [Fine Art Tutorials Courses](https://courses.finearttutorials.com): Main course landing page showcasing Drawing Fundamentals and art education offerings

## Learning Resources

- [Books](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/books): Product catalog featuring Drawing Mastery eBook and beginner drawing guides
- [Drawing for Beginners eBook](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/drawing-for-beginners-ebook-opt-in): Free eBook opt-in page offering Complete Drawing Guide for Beginners
